issues.description: Extraction unconditionally requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo does not include them or generate them, so the advertised demo/test fails.
The end-to-end test depends on missing repository data instead of creating fixtures, so the test suite fails on a clean checkout.
Committed generated artifacts reference a source story manifest that is absent from the repo, masking the broken extraction path.
The HF backend's auto dtype/device path loads the full model in default precision before moving it, which is fragile and likely to OOM for the stated Gemma target.
HF residual activation calls have no truncation, max-length guard, or batching, so long story files can exhaust memory.
Validation loads vector artifacts but does not verify backend, d_model, n_layers, or layer compatibility before computing activations.
Preference steering reconstructs a backend from CLI config without checking it matches the saved vector manifest.
pca_components_for_variance returns one component when threshold is 0, even though zero explained variance should require zero components.
project_out_components can remove arbitrary extra dimensions if given rank-deficient component rows.
Config values for emotions, topics, and stories_per_cell are not validated, causing late KeyErrors or empty reductions.
Context validation has no guard for manifests whose emotions do not overlap built-in scenarios, leading to an opaque np.stack failure.
Tiny backend emotion detection uses raw substring counts, causing false positives and making validation less trustworthy.
